description:
Investigate HTTPX issue #3621. Existing query parameters appear to be discarded when a caller provides additional parameters through params=.
Trace the behavior from the public request API to the URL construction and parameter-merging implementation. Identify the root cause using exact source evidence. Generate a minimal regression test that reproduces the reported behavior without making a network request. Propose the smallest correct patch consistent with the project's API contract. Validate the patch only in the shadow workspace, rerun the identical reproduction test, and run relevant existing regression tests. Report actual outputs, exit codes, source evidence, and the exact diff. Do not claim verification when execution was blocked or tests were not run.
